description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to be paid a minimum excise duty of Rs. 200 million per month by all arrack and beer manufacturers with effect from 01.04.2015 and declare that Annual License Fees and Triennial Authorization Fees published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. Nos. 1680/24 of 19.11.2010 and 1708/16 of 31.05.2011 respectively, are amended with effect from 01.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory amendments to the Excise Ordinance, specifically setting minimum excise duty requirements and modifying license fees and security amounts. It contains legal/regulatory instruments (Excise Notifications No. 973 and 974) that amend existing regulations under the Excise Ordinance, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. The mention of the Minister of Finance is incidental to the regulatory function being exercised.
